notes: DuckStation (PlayStation): the upstream AppImage, mounted; its real binary is run, never AppRun.
-batch quits when the game closes, so OpenGamepadUI gets the panel back instead of DuckStation's own UI; -- ends options in case a ROM name starts with '-'.
gui_args (Main menu > Emulators > Open): Big Picture is the pad-driven UI (the desktop one needs a mouse); no -batch, which would quit at once with no game.

gamepad_profile guide-hotkeys.yaml: hold Guide for L1 quick load, R1 quick save (the selected slot, game slot 1), R2 fast-forward, Start quit — as keyboard F1-F4, bound in the seeded settings.ini [Hotkeys] (LoadSelectedSaveState, SaveSelectedSaveState, FastForward, PowerOff). PowerOff is the pause menu's shut down: resume state and memory cards written, and -batch quits the app. Select + Start (pause menu) stays.
